theme.en: AI infrastructure confronts a memory and integration bill
theme.zh: AI基础设施直面存储与集成成本

dek.en: A possible Rubin memory reconfiguration, a multibillion-dollar sensor alliance, and a new custom-chip cycle point to the same constraint: AI capacity is being set by more than compute. The supporting software, packaging and memory layers are moving into the foreground.
dek.zh: Rubin可能调整内存配置、数十亿美元的图像传感器联盟以及新一轮自研芯片，指向同一约束：AI产能并不只由算力决定。支撑它的软件、封装和存储层正走到台前。

title.en: AI & Accelerators
title.zh: AI与加速器

title.en: Microsoft reportedly plans a next-generation AI chip reveal for September
title.zh: 微软据报计划于9月发布下一代AI芯片

summary.en: Microsoft plans to unveil a next-generation AI chip in September, according to a Reuters report citing The Information. A new in-house accelerator would give Azure another lever over the cost and availability of AI compute as hyperscalers diversify away from an all-GPU supply chain. The report is forward-looking, so specifications and production timing remain unconfirmed.
summary.zh: 路透援引The Information报道，微软计划在9月发布下一代AI芯片。若推出新的自研加速器，Azure在AI算力成本和供给上将多一个调节手段，也能降低对单一GPU供应链的依赖。该消息仍属前瞻性报道，规格和量产时间尚未得到确认。

title.en: Nvidia expands its agentic-AI toolkit into EDA
title.zh: Nvidia将智能体AI工具包扩展至EDA

summary.en: Nvidia has expanded its Agent Toolkit with PhysicsNeMo and CUDA-X libraries aimed at engineering and EDA workflows. The move is about connecting reasoning agents to simulation and domain software rather than using them only for code or document assistance. Its practical value will depend on whether chip-design teams can validate outputs inside established signoff flows.
summary.zh: Nvidia扩展了其Agent Toolkit，并加入面向工程与EDA工作流的PhysicsNeMo和CUDA-X库。重点是把推理智能体接入仿真和领域软件，而不只用于代码或文档辅助。其实际价值仍取决于芯片设计团队能否在既有签核流程中验证这些输出。

title.en: US retail prices for GeForce RTX 50 GPUs rise sharply
title.zh: 美国零售端GeForce RTX 50 GPU价格大幅上涨

summary.en: Newegg listings show some GeForce RTX 50-series cards priced as much as 39% above June levels, with median increases of 36% for the RTX 5070 and 27% for the RTX 5060. The report follows price increases in other regions and suggests Blackwell availability or channel pricing is tightening in the US. These are retail observations, not an announced Nvidia list-price change.
summary.zh: Newegg商品页面显示，部分GeForce RTX 50系列显卡价格较6月最高上涨39%；RTX 5070和RTX 5060的中位涨幅分别为36%和27%。该报道延续了其他地区的涨价迹象，表明Blackwell的供给或渠道定价在美国趋紧。这些是零售端观察，并非Nvidia宣布调整建议零售价。

title.en: Foundry & Manufacturing
title.zh: 晶圆代工与制造

title.en: Sony and TSMC commit $6.3 billion to next-generation image sensors
title.zh: Sony与台积电投入63亿美元开发下一代图像传感器

summary.en: Sony and TSMC are reported to be committing $6.3 billion to a next-generation image-sensor plant and related development. The partnership extends TSMC's role beyond logic foundry work into a strategically important specialty-semiconductor supply chain. It also puts more capital behind sensor technology as Samsung and Chinese rivals press into the market.
summary.zh: 据报道，Sony与台积电将为下一代图像传感器工厂及相关研发投入63亿美元。这项合作把台积电的角色从逻辑代工延伸至重要的特色半导体供应链。随着三星和中国竞争者加码，该项目也为传感器技术投入了更多资本。

title.en: Synopsys and Intel Foundry target system-level design for Intel 14A
title.zh: Synopsys与Intel Foundry面向Intel 14A推进系统级设计

summary.en: Synopsys and Intel Foundry expanded their collaboration around Intel 14A with production-oriented EDA, IP, multiphysics analysis and multi-die integration support. The objective is to reduce the design enablement work customers face before committing to the node. For Intel Foundry, a credible ecosystem is as important as the process roadmap in converting interest into tape-outs.
summary.zh: Synopsys与Intel Foundry围绕Intel 14A扩大合作，覆盖面向量产的EDA、IP、多物理场分析和多裸片集成支持。目标是降低客户在采用该制程前需要完成的设计使能工作。对Intel Foundry而言，可信的生态系统与制程路线图同样关键，才能把意向转化为流片。

title.en: Memory
title.zh: 存储

title.en: Nvidia reportedly tests lower-memory Rubin Ultra configurations
title.zh: Nvidia据报测试更低内存配置的Rubin Ultra

summary.en: Nvidia is reportedly testing at least three Rubin Ultra configurations, including a design with 192 GB of memory instead of the previously announced 1 TB of HBM4E. The reported alternatives also step back to HBM4, underscoring how advanced-memory availability can reshape accelerator configuration choices. Nvidia has not confirmed the tests, so the final product mix may differ.
summary.zh: 据报道，Nvidia正在测试至少三种Rubin Ultra配置，其中一种内存容量为192 GB，而此前公布的方案为1 TB HBM4E。报道中的替代方案还回退至HBM4，凸显先进存储供给能够改变加速器的配置选择。Nvidia尚未确认这些测试，最终产品组合仍可能不同。

title.en: Silicon Motion introduces PerformaShape for AI-oriented SSD tiers
title.zh: Silicon Motion推出面向AI SSD层级的PerformaShape技术

summary.en: Silicon Motion introduced its MonTitan SSD reference-design kit with PerformaShape technology at FMS 2026. The design targets enterprise SSDs used as a persistent tier for workloads such as KV-cache offload in agentic AI systems. It reflects the push to make flash behavior more predictable when memory capacity, rather than raw compute, limits inference deployments.
summary.zh: Silicon Motion在FMS 2026发布集成PerformaShape技术的MonTitan SSD参考设计套件。该设计面向企业级SSD作为持久层使用的场景，例如智能体AI系统中的KV缓存卸载。它反映出当内存容量而非原始算力限制推理部署时，业界正寻求让闪存表现更可预测。

title.en: Policy & Geopolitics
title.zh: 政策与地缘政治

title.en: US House China committee chair presses for Huawei export-rule enforcement
title.zh: 美国众议院中国问题委员会主席敦促执行华为出口规则

summary.en: Representative John Moolenaar urged the Trump administration to enforce chip export rules relating to Huawei, citing a potential loophole in current policy. The intervention keeps attention on whether controls can prevent advanced capability from reaching restricted Chinese technology firms through indirect channels. It is a policy request, not a newly announced regulatory action.
summary.zh: 众议员John Moolenaar敦促特朗普政府执行涉及华为的芯片出口规则，并指出现行政策可能存在漏洞。这一呼吁再次聚焦于管制能否阻止先进能力经由间接渠道流向受限的中国科技企业。这是政策诉求，而非新公布的监管行动。

title.en: Earnings & Markets
title.zh: 业绩与市场

title.en: TSMC July revenue rises 44.7% to a record NT$467.58 billion
title.zh: 台积电7月营收增长44.7%，创4,675.8亿新台币新高

summary.en: TSMC's July revenue reportedly rose 44.7% year on year to a record NT$467.58 billion. The monthly figure extends the evidence that demand for leading-edge logic and AI-related capacity remains unusually strong. Monthly revenue is not a full earnings release, but it is a timely signal for foundry utilization and the broader supply chain.
summary.zh: 据报道，台积电7月营收同比增长44.7%，达到创纪录的4,675.8亿新台币。这一月度数据进一步显示，先进逻辑和AI相关产能的需求仍异常强劲。月营收并非完整财报，但可及时反映晶圆厂产能利用率及更广泛供应链的动向。

theme.en: Inference research turns memory movement into architecture
theme.zh: 推理研究将内存移动变成架构问题

dek.en: This week's papers treat KV caches, heterogeneous memory and data transfer as first-class design variables rather than implementation details. The stronger results pair algorithm changes with an explicit hardware or serving-system assumption.
dek.zh: 本周论文将KV缓存、异构内存和数据传输视为一等设计变量，而非实现细节。更有说服力的工作都把算法改动与明确的硬件或推理系统假设结合起来。

title.en: Devices & Process
title.zh: 器件与工艺

title.en: Monolithic polarization-doped InGaN p-FETs and GaN n-FETs for complementary logic
title.zh: 用于互补逻辑的单片极化掺杂InGaN p-FET与GaN n-FET

papers.authors: Jingjing Yu, Teng Li, Yunhong Lao, et al.

summary.en: The authors monolithically integrate polarization-doped InGaN p-FETs with GaN n-FETs, addressing the weak p-type doping that has held back III-nitride complementary logic. Their p-FET exceeds 20 mA/mm; an inverter reaches 154.1 V/V gain and a ring oscillator posts 10.4 ns per stage. The work also integrates logic buffers with high-voltage GaN power transistors, though it is still a technology-platform result rather than a commercial process flow.
summary.zh: 作者将极化掺杂的InGaN p-FET与GaN n-FET单片集成，试图解决长期制约III族氮化物互补逻辑的p型掺杂效率问题。其p-FET电流密度超过20 mA/mm，反相器增益达到154.1 V/V，环形振荡器的单级延迟为10.4 ns。论文还展示了与高压GaN功率晶体管集成的逻辑缓冲器，但这仍是技术平台成果，尚非商业工艺流程。

title.en: AI Accelerators & Compute-in-Memory
title.zh: AI加速器与存算一体

title.en: Dual-view memory for dynamic NPU-PIM LLM inference
title.zh: 面向动态NPU-PIM大模型推理的双视图内存

papers.authors: Shixin Zhao, Lian Liu, Tian Han, et al.

summary.en: This paper argues that a single device-biased memory layout breaks down when an LLM tensor can move between an NPU and PIM across prefill, decode or MoE routing. Its PIM-as-Flexible-Memory design keeps a joint physical layout while exposing device-specific logical views, avoiding duplication and relayout. The open question is the translation and scheduling overhead on real NPU-PIM hardware.
summary.zh: 论文认为，当同一大模型张量会在预填充、解码或MoE路由阶段于NPU和PIM之间移动时，单一的设备偏置内存布局会失效。其PIM-as-Flexible-Memory设计保留联合优化的物理布局，同时向不同设备提供各自的逻辑视图，从而避免复制和重排。未解问题是实际NPU-PIM硬件上的地址转换和调度开销。

title.en: HeteroPanacea models prefill-decode-attention-FFN specialization
title.zh: HeteroPanacea建模预填充、解码、注意力与FFN专用化

papers.authors: Przemyslaw Forys, Haoran Wu, Can Xiao, et al.

summary.en: HeteroPanacea is a simulation framework for agentic inference that separates prefill, decode, attention and FFN onto heterogeneous hardware choices. It combines disaggregated quantization, automated parallelization scheduling and device specialization to explore architecture trade-offs. Its conclusions necessarily depend on modeled hardware and workload assumptions.
summary.zh: HeteroPanacea是面向智能体推理的仿真框架，将预填充、解码、注意力和FFN映射到不同的异构硬件选择。它结合了解耦量化、自动并行调度和设备专用化来考察架构取舍。其结论必然依赖所建模的硬件和负载假设。

title.en: AI Inference Systems & Algorithms
title.zh: AI推理系统与算法

title.en: CubicQuant: parametric non-uniform low-bit weights for LLM inference
title.zh: CubicQuant：用于大模型推理的参数化非均匀低比特权重

summary.en: CubicQuant proposes a monotonic cubic mapping that turns dense integer codes into non-uniform weight reconstruction levels from 1 to 8 bits. It aims to retain the flexibility of learned codebooks without irregular decoding or extensive metadata, and describes packed-weight GPU execution. The central trade-off is whether per-group curve fitting improves enough over conventional quantization to justify extra format and kernel complexity.
summary.zh: CubicQuant提出单调三次映射，将密集整数编码转换为1至8比特的非均匀权重重建等级。它试图保留学习型码本的灵活性，同时避免不规则解码和大量元数据，并给出了打包权重的GPU执行方式。关键取舍在于，按组拟合曲线带来的提升是否足以抵消额外的格式与内核复杂度。

title.en: Cascade: latency-budget scheduling for fair LLM serving
title.zh: Cascade：面向公平大模型服务的延迟预算调度

papers.authors: Muhammad Adnan, R. Mahapatra, Prashant J. Nair, et al.

summary.en: Cascade assigns each request a continuously updated latency budget derived from its SLO, predicted remaining work, KV-cache state and current load. It uses that budget to coordinate both request ordering and KV-cache management, rather than treating deadlines as a queueing rule alone. Accurate remaining-time prediction remains the critical dependency.
summary.zh: Cascade为每个请求分配持续更新的延迟预算，依据其SLO、剩余工作量预测、KV缓存状态和当前负载计算。该预算同时协调请求排序与KV缓存管理，而不是只把截止时间当作排队规则。关键仍在于剩余时间预测是否准确。

title.en: RAC compresses activations for split LLM inference
title.zh: RAC为分割式大模型推理压缩激活值

papers.authors: Guotao Yang, M. Zhao, Haopeng Li, et al.

summary.en: RAC reduces the communication bottleneck in local-cloud-local split inference by compressing boundary activations with references from repeated context. It combines exact-token retrieval, causal predictors, grouped affine alignment and calibrated residual quantization. The authors report raw-to-RAC ratios of 1.24–2.72× for time to first token and 1.01–2.79× for time per output token; the benefit should be strongest where repeated context exists and network transfer dominates.
summary.zh: RAC利用重复上下文提供的参考信息压缩边界激活值，以缓解本地—云端—本地分割推理中的通信瓶颈。它结合精确token检索、因果预测器、分组仿射对齐和校准残差量化。作者报告首token时间的Raw-to-RAC比值为1.24–2.72倍、每输出token时间为1.01–2.79倍；收益在重复上下文存在且网络传输占主导时最明显。

title.en: ATFlash prunes attention by RoPE wavelength
title.zh: ATFlash按RoPE波长裁剪注意力计算

papers.authors: Shun-ichiro Hayashi, Daichi Mukunoki, Tetsuya Hoshino, et al.

summary.en: ATFlash uses the frequency-pair structure of rotary position embeddings to give each RoPE wavelength its own distance window. Unlike a conventional sliding window, every key remains reachable through low-frequency pairs while shorter-wavelength terms are pruned. On Qwen2.5-0.5B and Llama-3.2-3B, it removes 37–48% of query-key inner-product terms while retaining a 96–98% top-1 match rate, though the evidence is limited to the evaluated models and benchmarks.
summary.zh: ATFlash利用旋转位置编码的频率对结构，为每个RoPE波长设置独立的距离窗口。不同于传统滑动窗口，每个key仍可通过低频对访问，而短波长项被裁剪。在Qwen2.5-0.5B和Llama-3.2-3B上，它去除了37–48%的query-key内积项，同时保持96–98%的top-1匹配率；不过证据仍限于所评测的模型与基准。
